title: Implement until spec passes: R1 usage and cost metrics
description: Done when: the wip tag is removed from 01_usage_tokens.feature, step definitions are written, and cargo test --test bdd passes for its scenarios.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented until the spec passes. @wip dropped from features/01_structure/01_usage_tokens.feature; all 7 scenarios pass in cargo test --test bdd (17 scenarios total). Schema: Usage (input/output/cache_read/cache_write/cached_input/reasoning tokens, model — absent fields stay None, never zero), SessionCost with per-model map, RateLimitState, Message.usage/turn_id, Session.usage/cost/rate_limit/turns, Session::turn_usage/thread_usage accumulators. fmt, clippy -D warnings, doc -D warnings, 8 doctests, BDD all green.

right_now_summary: The usage and cost metrics spec passes, with all seven scenarios green and the new schema and accumulators implemented.
